thread.title: Earnings Preview: Apple, AMD, Verizon, Other Giants to Report Crucial Q4

author: Jacob Sonenshine
title: Earnings Preview: Apple, AMD, Verizon, Other Giants to Report Crucial Q4

organizations.name: ubs global wealth management's chief investment office

text:
Several U.S. corporate giants are reporting quarterly earnings Tuesday, January 29, in what is likely to be a market-shaping batch of earnings.
"We now face a potentially pivotal week," wrote UBS Global Wealth Management's Chief Investment Office in a note out Monday morning. One huge key that January's rally hinges on, according to UBS, is that "another quarter of the S&P 500 reports this week."
Apple Apple Inc. ( AAPL ) reports its first quarter for the fiscal year 2019 earnings report after the market closes Tuesday January 29. Analysts are expecting adjusted earnings-per-share of $4.17 on $83.97 billion of revenue.
AMD Advanced Micro Devices Inc. ( AMD ) reports fourth quarter 2018 earnings results after the closing bell Tuesday. Wall Street is expecting adjusted EPS of 82 cents, which would represent a 2.5% year-over-year growth rate. GAAP EPS is expected to be 51 cents, a 15.6% decrease. Revenue is expected to be $1.44 billion.
eBay eBay Inc. ( EBAY ) reports fourth quarter earnings after the closing bell Tuesday. Analysts are looking for adjusted EPS of 68 cents, but GAAP EPS of 89 cents. Revenue is expected to be $2.87 billion.
Verizon Verizon Communications Inc. ( VZ ) reports fourth quarter earnings before the market opens Tuesday. Analysts estimated adjusted EPS of $1.09 on revenue of $34.44 billion.
Pfizer Pfizer Inc. ( PFE ) reports fourth quarter earnings before the market opens Tuesday. Analysts are expecting GAP EPS of 53 cents and adjusted EPS of 63 cents on revenue of $13.0 billion.
Allergan Allergan PLC ( AGN ) reports fourth quarter earnings before the market opens Tuesday. Analysts are looking for a GAAP loss per share of 44 cents and adjusted EPS of $4.16 on revenue of $4 billion. Allergan just announced a quarterly cash dividend for the first quarter of 2019 of 74 cents a share, bringing its dividend yield up to above 1.88%.
3M 3M Co. ( MMM ) reports fourth quarter earnings ahead of the opening bell Tuesday. Analysts are expecting adjusted EPS of $2.77 on revenue of $7.86 billion.
Whirlpool Whirlpool Corp. ( WHR ) reports fourth quarter earnings after the closing bell Monday. Wall Street is expecting GAAP EPS of $3.56 and adjusted EPS of $4.23 on revenue of $5.76 billion.
